$comment: Reviewed npm audit exceptions for the root tree, enforced by scripts/audit-gate.mjs (CI 'Run security audit'). Each entry names ONE advisory for ONE package. An exception may only be added when the fix requires a semver-major upgrade that needs its own change; it must expire. The gate fails on any unlisted high/critical advisory (full tree) or moderate+ advisory (production tree), on any expired entry, and on any entry whose advisory is no longer reported, so this list can only shrink.

exceptions.reason: Memory exhaustion validating oversized constrained collections. Fixed only in zod 4.6.6+; the repository pins zod 3.25.76 and its validation code uses the v3 API.
exceptions.remediation: Migrate to zod 4 (breaking API) in a dedicated change; until then bound input size before schema validation at system boundaries.

exceptions.reason: Inherited libvips vulnerabilities. sharp arrives transitively via agentic-flow 2.x (@huggingface/transformers); the only fix path is agentic-flow 3.5.5, a semver-major upgrade of a core runtime integration.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade agentic-flow to 3.x in a dedicated change with integration testing.

exceptions.reason: Inherited libheif vulnerabilities; same agentic-flow 2.x transitive path as GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade agentic-flow to 3.x in a dedicated change with integration testing.

exceptions.reason: Inherited librsvg vulnerability; same agentic-flow 2.x transitive path as GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade agentic-flow to 3.x in a dedicated change with integration testing.

exceptions.reason: AbortSignal cancellation bypass. Vulnerable glob is pinned by agentic-flow 2.x; npm audit's only fix is agentic-flow 3.5.5 (semver-major).
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade agentic-flow to 3.x in a dedicated change with integration testing.

exceptions.reason: globparts amplification DoS, reached through the agentic-flow 2.x glob dependency; fix requires agentic-flow 3.5.5 (semver-major).
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade agentic-flow to 3.x in a dedicated change with integration testing.

exceptions.reason: Development-only: tinypool is the Vitest 3 worker pool, not shipped in any published package. Exploitation needs attacker control of worker options inside the local test run. Fixed only by Vitest 5 (semver-major).
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade the root test runner to Vitest 5 and re-baseline the CI test ratchet in a dedicated change.

exceptions.reason: Development-only Vitest 3 worker pool; same conditions as GHSA-5gmw-xhrv-c9v3.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade the root test runner to Vitest 5 and re-baseline the CI test ratchet in a dedicated change.

exceptions.reason: Development-only: affects the Vitest browser/mocker dev server, which the CI ratchet does not start. Fixed only by Vitest 5 (semver-major).
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade the root test runner to Vitest 5 in a dedicated change.

exceptions.reason: Development-only; the same advisory as the vitest entry, reported for the mocker package itself.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade the root test runner to Vitest 5 in a dedicated change.

exceptions.reason: Development-only: unauthenticated manual-mock registration on the Vitest dev server, which the CI ratchet does not start. Fixed only by Vitest 5 (semver-major).
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade the root test runner to Vitest 5 in a dedicated change.
